f3_program: collection("bucket.sourball_candies", "sourball_candy", "bucket", source("a bucket of 30 candies"))
collection("candy_eaters", "person", "group", source("all of them"))
member("candy_eaters", "nellie", source("Nellie"))
member("candy_eaters", "jacob", source("Jacob"))
member("candy_eaters", "lana", source("Lana"))
observe(at("bucket.sourball_candies.count", "initial"), 30, "count", source("a bucket of 30 candies"))
observe(at("nellie.sourball_candies.eating_capacity.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("Nellie can eat 12 sourball candies before crying"))

fraction_of(at("jacob.sourball_candies.eating_capacity.count", "current"), at("nellie.sourball_candies.eating_capacity.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("Jacob can only manage half of that number of candies"))
offset(at("lana.sourball_candies.eating_capacity.count", "current"), at("jacob.sourball_candies.eating_capacity.count", "current"), -3, "count", source("Lana can only do three fewer than Jacob"))

consume("nellie_eats_until_crying", "nellie", at("bucket.sourball_candies.count", "current"), at("nellie.sourball_candies.eating_capacity.count", "current"), source("all of them ate until they cried"))
consume("jacob_eats_until_crying", "jacob", at("bucket.sourball_candies.count", "current"), at("jacob.sourball_candies.eating_capacity.count", "current"), source("all of them ate until they cried"))
consume("lana_eats_until_crying", "lana", at("bucket.sourball_candies.count", "current"), at("lana.sourball_candies.eating_capacity.count", "current"), source("all of them ate until they cried"))
collection("candy_eaters.remaining_sourball_candy_shares", "share", "candy_eaters", source("divide the remaining candies in the bucket equally"))
partition("candy_eaters.remaining_sourball_candy_shares", at("bucket.sourball_candies.count", "current"), source("divide the remaining candies in the bucket equally"))
query("value", "candy_eaters.remaining_sourball_candy_shares.each.count")
assumptions: The pronouns "all of them" and "they" refer to Nellie, Jacob, and Lana.
The requested annual total requires a month-to-year conversion that is neither stated in the source nor provided by the F3-v1 allowlist.

f3_program: collection("car_buyers", "friend", "group", source("A group of six friends"))
observe(at("car_buyers.count", "initial"), 6, "count", source("A group of six friends"))
observe(at("car.purchase.remaining_cost.amount", "initial"), 1700, "dollar", source("The cost of the car is $1700"))
produce("car_wash_fundraiser", "car_buyers", at("car_buyers.car_wash_proceeds.amount", "current"), 500, source("At the car wash, they earn $500"))

remove("apply_car_wash_proceeds", "car_buyers", at("car.purchase.remaining_cost.amount", "current"), event_field("car_wash_fundraiser", "quantity"), source("which would be taken out of the total cost"))

quotient_relation(at("car_buyers.each_payment.amount", "before_brad_withdrawal"), at("car.purchase.remaining_cost.amount", "current"), at("car_buyers.count", "initial"), source("The remaining cost would be split between the six friends"))
remove("brad_withdraws", "brad", at("car_buyers.count", "current"), 1, source("Brad decided not to join in the purchase of the car"))

quotient_relation(at("car_buyers.each_payment.amount", "after_brad_withdrawal"), at("car.purchase.remaining_cost.amount", "current"), at("car_buyers.count", "current"), source("they plan to share the cost equally"))
query("difference", at("car_buyers.each_payment.amount", "before_brad_withdrawal"), at("car_buyers.each_payment.amount", "after_brad_withdrawal"))
assumptions: Brad is one of the original six friends, and the equal-sharing plan continues among the participating friends after his withdrawal.

f3_program: observe(at("road.unpaved.length", "initial"), 16, "mile", source("a newly constructed 16-mile road"))
observe(at("asphalt.gravel_bags.count", "per_truckload"), 2, "bag", source("Each truckloads of asphalt uses two bags of gravel"))
multiple(at("asphalt.gravel_bags.count", "per_truckload"), at("asphalt.pitch_barrels.count", "per_truckload"), 5, source("five times as many bags of gravel as it does barrels of pitch"))
observe(at("roadwork.asphalt_truckloads.count", "per_mile"), 3, "truckload", source("three truckloads of asphalt to pave each mile of road"))
remove("pave_day_1", "roadwork_company", at("road.unpaved.length", "current"), 4, source("The company paved 4 miles of road on one day"))
offset("road.paved.day_2.length", scale(event_field("pave_day_1", "quantity"), 2), -1, "mile", source("one mile less than double that"))
remove("pave_day_2", "roadwork_company", at("road.unpaved.length", "current"), "road.paved.day_2.length", source("one mile less than double that on the second day"))
same(at("road.unpaved.length", "day_3"), at("road.unpaved.length", "current"), source("remaining road on the third day"))

rate_relation("roadwork.day_3.asphalt_truckloads.count", at("roadwork.asphalt_truckloads.count", "per_mile"), at("road.unpaved.length", "day_3"), source("It takes three truckloads of asphalt to pave each mile of road"))

product_relation("roadwork.day_3.pitch_barrels.count", "roadwork.day_3.asphalt_truckloads.count", at("asphalt.pitch_barrels.count", "per_truckload"), source("Each truckloads of asphalt uses two bags of gravel and five times as many bags of gravel as it does barrels of pitch to make"))
query("value", "roadwork.day_3.pitch_barrels.count")
assumptions: The word "that" in "double that" refers to the four miles paved on the first day.

f3_program: collection("nicole.older_sisters", "person", "family", source("Nicole has three older sisters"))
observe(at("nicole.older_sisters.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("Nicole has three older sisters"))
member("nicole.older_sisters", "nicole.first_older_sister", source("Her first older sister"))
member("nicole.older_sisters", "nicole.next_oldest_sister", source("The next oldest sister"))
member("nicole.older_sisters", "nicole.oldest_sister", source("The oldest"))
observe(at("nicole.clothing.count", "initial"), 10, "piece", source("Nicole started with 10 pieces of clothing"))
fraction_of(at("nicole.first_older_sister.clothing.count", "initial"), at("nicole.clothing.count", "initial"), 1, 2, source("Her first older sister had half as many clothes as Nicole"))
offset(at("nicole.next_oldest_sister.clothing.count", "initial"), at("nicole.clothing.count", "initial"), 2, "piece", source("The next oldest sister had 2 more pieces of clothing than Nicole"))

mean_relation(at("nicole.oldest_sister.clothing.count", "initial"), at("nicole.clothing.count", "initial"), at("nicole.first_older_sister.clothing.count", "initial"), at("nicole.next_oldest_sister.clothing.count", "initial"), source("The oldest had the average of what her three younger sisters had"))

transfer("first_older_sister_gives_clothes", "nicole.first_older_sister", at("nicole.first_older_sister.clothing.count", "current"), at("nicole.clothing.count", "current"), at("nicole.first_older_sister.clothing.count", "initial"), source("They have all outgrown their clothes and have given them all to Nicole"))

transfer("next_oldest_sister_gives_clothes", "nicole.next_oldest_sister", at("nicole.next_oldest_sister.clothing.count", "current"), at("nicole.clothing.count", "current"), at("nicole.next_oldest_sister.clothing.count", "initial"), source("They have all outgrown their clothes and have given them all to Nicole"))

transfer("oldest_sister_gives_clothes", "nicole.oldest_sister", at("nicole.oldest_sister.clothing.count", "current"), at("nicole.clothing.count", "current"), at("nicole.oldest_sister.clothing.count", "initial"), source("They have all outgrown their clothes and have given them all to Nicole"))
query("value", at("nicole.clothing.count", "current"))
assumptions: The oldest sister's three younger sisters are Nicole and the two other older sisters, and all clothing comparisons describe pre-transfer holdings.
